sourceConcerns: s.s1.st.1.after assumes inferred intention more certain than literal evidence; source adjudication pending
s.s1.st.2.after mentions another shop matching clues, distinct from explicitly proposed friend idea

title.translation: Wetin Jun want? Use new clues change your thinking

goal.translation: As new parts of the conversation appear, guess again wetin the speaker want, then explain how your guess change.

material.translation: Jun dey talk to Jun mama for house. You go see the words one part at a time.

thinking.0.translation: Guess the meaning wey person no talk directly

thinking.1.translation: Change your judgment when new information enter

prereq.0.translation: Simple English words like small, hurt and closed

s.s1.prompt.translation: Read Jun words one part at a time. For each part, guess wetin Jun want.

s.s1.hint.0.translation: Find one new word for this part.

s.s1.hint.1.translation: Compare your earlier guess with each new clue to see whether dem agree.

s.s1.st.0.ask.translation: With only this statement, which guess about wetin Jun want from Jun mama make most sense?

s.s1.st.0.after.translation: One sentence alone no fit make us know for sure. Jun fit want new shoes, or Jun fit just dey state a fact.

s.s1.st.0.r.a.translation: The clue never mention P.E. class or missing class.

s.s1.st.0.o.b.translation: Jun hope say Jun mama go buy new shoes.

s.s1.st.0.o.c.translation: Jun fit just dey talk say the shoes small.

s.s1.st.1.info.translation: Jun: "They hurt when I run. We have P.E. (physical exercise) class tomorrow."

s.s1.st.1.ask.translation: Read the new clue too, then guess again wetin Jun want.

s.s1.st.1.after.translation: Pain together with P.E. tomorrow make the wish to solve am before tomorrow clearer. If your first guess na only stating a fact, this new clue fit make you change am.

s.s1.st.1.o.a.translation: Jun want solve the foot pain before P.E. tomorrow.

s.s1.st.1.o.b.translation: Jun still only dey state facts.

s.s1.st.1.r.b.translation: Saying say the feet hurt and P.E. dey tomorrow na clue say Jun want solution. Just stating facts fit work for first stage, but e no fit these new clues well.

s.s1.st.1.r.c.translation: Jun never talk say Jun want miss class. Reading the pain and tomorrow P.E. as search for solution fit the clues better.

s.s1.st.2.info.translation: Mom: "The shoe shop is closed today."  Jun: "Hana's feet are the same size as mine. Maybe she has extra shoes!"

s.s1.st.2.ask.translation: Use the final clue guess wetin Jun go do.

s.s1.st.2.after.translation: The shop close today, so buying new shoes there today no fit work. Trying another shop or asking the friend about shoes fit the new clues. If you only consider new shoes today, you need change that plan.

s.s1.st.2.o.a.translation: Jun go the shop today buy new shoes.

s.s1.st.2.r.a.translation: This one no agree with the clue say the shop close today.

s.s1.st.2.o.b.translation: Jun ask Jun mama make dem try another shop early tomorrow morning.

s.s1.st.2.r.b.translation: This plan fit work too. But the idea Jun actually mention last na about the friend.

s.s1.st.2.o.c.translation: Jun think about borrowing shoes from friend wey get the same foot size.

s.s1.reflect.translation: Your guess change for any stage? If e change, mention one sentence wey make you change am.

s.s2.prompt.translation: Which clue make Jun words begin sound like wanting solution before tomorrow, instead of only talking?

s.s2.hint.0.translation: Read the three clues in order. Find the first place wey the number of possible guesses reduce.

s.s2.hint.1.translation: Remove each clue in turn and check whether the wish for solution still clear.

s.s2.o.a.translation: "They hurt when I run. We have P.E. class tomorrow."

s.s2.r.b.translation: This sentence dey from the beginning. More than one guess still fit am.

s.s2.r.c.translation: This clue block one solution, the shop. But the earlier clue don already show the wish for solution.

s.s2.explain.translation: Pain together with P.E. tomorrow create problem wey get time limit. That na why Jun words sound like wanting solution.
